title: add RAG + agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) quickstarts, agent/tool-calling examples, and the corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: make it easy for developers to onboard to RAG + agent workflows using Redwood's API and quickstart code samples (Python + TypeScript) and to demonstrate tool calling patterns (search, vector DB lookup, and external API calls).

What this PR includes: - New quickstarts: redwood-examples/rag/quickstart-python and quickstart-ts (end-to-end RAG with vector store, retrieval, and prompt templates). - Agent examples: redwood-examples/agents/tool_caller.py and agents/tool_caller.ts demonstrating tool registration, secure tool invocation, and structured output parsing. - RAG templates: redwood-docs/content/guides/rag-templates.md with recommended template patterns (single-turn vs multi-turn, chunking heuristics, prompt eval tips). - Docs site: updated sidebar and landing page examples, added a "Agents & Tool Calling" guide and links to the quickstarts. - Tests and CI: added a lightweight smoke test to examples CI that validates sample prompts run against the dev sandbox (mocked).

Checklist: - [x] Quickstart code (Python + TS) - [x] Docs guide and templates - [x] Example agent demonstrating tool calling + structured output - [x] CI smoke test added to examples workflow - [x] Reviewed for security: no secrets included, tools called via mocked stubs in CI

Testing and verification: Local tested against dev sandbox using mocked vector DB and search endpoints. CI runs an examples workflow that executes the smoke test (passes in this PR). Reviewed security with Priya (no hard-coded API keys).

Notes for reviewers: Focus review on content correctness in the docs and the agent tool interface examples. The quickstarts intentionally use small local vector stores and provide comments on production hardening (indexing, chunk size, and relevance tuning). We will follow up with additional language bindings for Go once this pattern is stabilized.

Related: INC-981 (support case for customers confused by tool calling examples), ENG-4123 (RAG quickstart epic).
